name: Sumiyō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sumiyō village emblem in green: an outlined ring crossed by a stylised character of angular strokes.
history: Flag of the former village of Sumiyō in Kagoshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-03-20. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 February 1967.

features.role: Sumiyō village emblem — an outlined ring crossed by a stylised character of angular strokes
